title: Cohomology commutes with extension of scalars along a field extension
statement:
Let $K\subset L$ be fields and let $C=(C^r,d^r)$ be a cochain complex of $K$-vector spaces, with cohomology modules $\mathrm H^i(C)$ [def-weil-derived-category-cohomology-functor]. Let $C\otimes_KL$ be the complex of $L$-vector spaces with terms $C^r\otimes_KL$ and differentials $d^r\otimes_KL$ (extension of scalars termwise [def-weil-vector-space-scalar-extension]). Then for every integer $i$ the $L$-linear map

$$
\mathrm H^i(C)\otimes_KL\longrightarrow\mathrm H^i(C\otimes_KL),\qquad[x]\otimes\lambda\longmapsto[x\otimes\lambda],
$$

is well defined and an isomorphism of $L$-vector spaces, natural in $C$ (compatible with the maps induced by morphisms of complexes). In particular, $C\otimes_KL$ has finite-dimensional cohomology over $L$ when $C$ has finite-dimensional cohomology over $K$, and a quasi-isomorphism $C\to C'$ of complexes of $K$-vector spaces induces a quasi-isomorphism $C\otimes_KL\to C'\otimes_KL$. For a tower $K\subset L\subset M$ the isomorphisms are compatible with the canonical isomorphisms $(V\otimes_KL)\otimes_LM\cong V\otimes_KM$ of [def-weil-vector-space-scalar-extension]: the square formed by $\mathrm H^i(C)\otimes_KM$, $(\mathrm H^i(C)\otimes_KL)\otimes_LM$, $\mathrm H^i(C\otimes_KL)\otimes_LM$ and $\mathrm H^i((C\otimes_KL)\otimes_LM)\cong\mathrm H^i(C\otimes_KM)$ commutes.

source.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Section 'Flat modules' (Tag 00H9), Definition 00HB (M flat: −⊗_R M exact) — L is a free K-module (a K-basis exists), hence flat; Homology, Lemma 010N (exact functors between abelian categories) and the definition of H^i of a cochain complex in Section 'Complexes' (Tag 010V): an exact additive functor preserves kernels and images, hence carries Ker(d^i)/Im(d^{i-1}) to Ker(F d^i)/Im(F d^{i-1}). The blueprint uses this without a name in the stagewise definition of $\mathrm H^i$ on $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)$
